title: Babel Fish - The Oddest Thing In The Universe - The Hitchhiker's Guide To The Galaxy - BBC
summary: The BBC TV version of the Babel Fish passage from The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, with Ford and Arthur aboard a Vogon ship, narrated over the show's hand-drawn animated Guide entry.
why: HN points to it for the memorable hand-animated computer graphics, which still hold up, and as the TV rendition of a famous passage.

quote.text: The animation is one of the most memorable aspects of the TV series and, despite being almost 40 years old, still holds up really well
